source_refs.note: Ideal Fluid: a main subheading of 5.8 Steady, non-viscous and ideal fluid, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-104.

blocks.text: Jo fluid yeh shartein poori kare use ideal (perfect) fluid kehte hain:

items: Fluid non-viscous ho, yani fluid ki saath saath wali layers (tahon) ke beech koi friction (ragar) ki force na ho.
Fluid incompressible ho, yani dabane se na dabe aur us ki density constant rahe.
